run_open_images_fake_data: run the open_images module to generate fake Open Images v4 dataset files with train, test, and validation splits
generate_train_files: generate train split files including tar archives with random JPEG images and CSV label annotations
generate_test_files: generate test split files including tar archive with random JPEG images and CSV label annotations
generate_validation_files: generate validation split files including tar archive with random JPEG images and CSV label annotations
write_bbox_labels: write CSV file with bounding box annotations including coordinates and visual attributes for each image
